{
  "reviewed_docx_sha256": "026288491716d626a7bcac14a515313da7846f5a204703da9bad3a9010edf214",
  "reviewed_candidate": "0097 / requirement I18-E05 / revision R07 (status CANDIDATE_NOT_FORMALLY_ACCEPTED)",
  "reviewed_extract_sha256": "8e9ae4c5bc7176d4e1d7c4f2451ee389ba831300ff7b2b33ac53d51a0a51e79f",
  "scope": "targeted_delta",
  "scope_detail": "R07-vs-R06 delta only: closure of R06 findings F2 and F3, plus a regression scan of the two added blocks against the packet-supplied DOCX text extraction, the official page-7 readback, and the contract-mapping excerpt (03_157_CHECKBOX_BLUEPRINTS.md lines 261-265). R06 rows that already passed were not re-reviewed.",
  "overall_verdict": "PASS",
  "overall_statement": "The R07 semantic delta passes. Both R06 findings F2 and F3 are completely and accurately closed in the exact DOCX SHA-256 026288491716d626a7bcac14a515313da7846f5a204703da9bad3a9010edf214, and the added content introduces no material regression. This is a semantic-delta PASS on a candidate only; it is not a visual/layout PASS and it does not grant formal association acceptance of 0097.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "prior_severity": "minor",
      "prior_title": "Item 107 mapping is asserted from Blueprint scope rather than tied to an explicit official-table text sample",
      "verdict": "FIXED",
      "verdict_code": "PASS",
      "locator": "DOCX §7.1「官方需求與本文內容對照（來源映射）」: new block inserted after the source-mapping row 「文類與職責劃分：獨立之問卷工具與分析報告」 and immediately before the heading 「7.2 負向近鄰查核與邊界防護審查」. Block text = 「同頁評分層級界線（官方查核佐證表第 7 頁）：本件只對應 I18-E05 的 2 分能力提升要求，因本工具呈現目標客戶與學員對訓練後能力提升的問卷及樣本分析；本件不宣稱達到其他評分層級，也不主張組織績效改善。為避免混讀，同頁相鄰 3 分、4 分的相關參考佐證原文如下，兩者均非本件已具備的證據：」+ bullet 「3 分」「4 分」 + closing paragraph 「本件目標仍是 2 分欄所列的能力提升看法，不把上列績效改善或組織績效文字納入 0097 的範圍；官方方框序號仍依原 PDF 可查資訊標為 UNKNOWN，不由品質契約流水號、文件 ID 或需求 ID 推算。」 Page numbers are not re-verifiable in R07 (layout blocked), so the locator is by section heading plus quoted text.",
      "closure_basis": "The F2 minimum_repair is satisfied through its first option: the two neighbouring sub-tier 佐證 wordings are now quoted in §7.1 verbatim, the targeted sub-tier (2 分) is explicitly named, the reason for targeting it is given, and the adjacent3 分/4 分 wordings are expressly excluded as evidence this document does not hold. The genre mapping is therefore auditable from the document alone. The alternative option (mark the cell UNKNOWN) was not needed and was not used.",
      "quote_fidelity_check": {
        "result": "EXACT_MATCH_WORDING (whitespace/line-break artifacts of the PDF extraction only)",
        "tier_3_official_page7_readback": "問卷調查及課後行動計畫評估表等顯示目標客戶及學員認為訓練有績效改善的效果。",
        "tier_3_docx_quote": "問卷調查及課後行動計畫評估表等顯示目標客戶及學員認為訓練有績效改善的效果。",
        "tier_4_official_page7_readback": "問卷調查及課後行動計畫評估表等顯示目標客戶及學員認為訓練對組織績效的改善及提升均有顯著的效果。",
        "tier_4_docx_quote": "問卷調查及課後行動計畫評估表等顯示目標客戶及學員認為訓練對組織績效的改善及提升均有顯著的效果。",
        "attribution_check": "Both quotes are correctly attributed: the 3 分 quote is the first bullet under the official 「3分之常見參考佐證資料：」 list and the 4 分 quote is the first bullet under the official 「4分之常見參考佐證資料：」 list in the supplied readback. No clause added, dropped, reordered, or paraphrased; the only differences from the readback are the PDF extraction artifacts 「行動計 畫」 and 「改善 及提升」, which the DOCX normalizes.",
 "no_overreach_check": "The DOCX does not claim to satisfy the 3 分 or 4 分 tiers, does not claim 組織績效改善, and does not present the quoted 3 分/4 分 text as its own evidence. This is consistent with the document's front-page UNKNOWN serial, §7.3 (SAMPLE_ONLY / NOT_RATED, TTQS 分級未判定) and the0096/0098 negative-neighbour boundaries in §7.2."
      },
      "serial_discipline_check": "PASS — the official box serial remains UNKNOWN. The added text explicitly forbids deriving it from the quality-contract sequence, the document ID, or the requirement ID, and the contract value 106 (I18-L2) is not substituted anywhere. This matches the contract-mapping note that 106 is a separate 157-contract sequence value and must not stand in for an official printed serial.",
      "residual_caveat": "The supplied official page-7 readback is truncated at the top (its first line is the tail 「的效果。」, immediately followed by the 「4分」 label), so the packet does not print the complete2 分 row text. Placement of the candidate's cited wording 「認為訓練有達成能力提升的效果。」 at the 2 分 level therefore rests on (a) the contract-mapping excerpt's framing of I18-E05 as the 2-point wording and (b) the readback's reading order, where the 2 分 row's 內涵說明 tail immediately precedes the 4 分 label. The DOCX itself claims no serial and asserts only the 2 分 tier. This is a source-availability limitation of the packet, not a defect in the R07 repair.",
      "verdict_rationale": "F2's complaint was that the item-107/§7.1 genre mapping could not be audited from the document alone. It now can: the target tier is named and justified, both neighbouring sub-tier wordings are quoted accurately from the official table, and the non-target tiers are fenced off. Closed completely and accurately."
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "prior_severity": "minor",
      "prior_title": "Per-item denominator disclosure for the paired means is implicit rather than stated in the summary table",
      "verdict": "FIXED",
      "verdict_code": "PASS",
      "locator": "DOCX §5.5.3「兩群體描述統計摘要」: new paragraph 「彙總權重與分母：學員層為 8 人 × 3 構面 = 24 個有效配對項目；觀察者層為 4 人 × 3 構面 = 12 個有效配對項目。下表前測、後測及差值均值，分別以 24 或 12 個配對項目作分母，按有效配對項目加權，不是把三個構面平均值再平均；兩組不合併。本合成示例各列均有完整有效配對；若真實施測有缺答或 N/O，須依各指標實際有效配對數重列分母並重算。」 positioned after the two per-construct tables (學員 N=8 / 觀察者 N=4) and immediately before the pooled描述指標 table (全部配對題前均值 2.42 (58/24) / 2.33 (28/12); 全部配對題後均值 3.38 (81/24) / 3.17 (38/12); 配對差值均值 +0.96 (23/24) / +0.83 (10/12)).",
      "closure_basis": "The F3 minimum_repair is satisfied through its second option: the recommended single line is effectively present — 8 人 × 3 構面 = 24 個配對項目 / 4 人 × 3 構面 = 12 個配對項目, item-weighted — printed adjacent to the summary table, plus an explicit statement that the two groups are not pooled, that the synthetic case has complete valid pairs on every indicator, and that real runs must re-state per-indicator denominators and recompute if N/O or missing answers exist. The pooling weight is now explicit without recomputation; the optional 配對項目數 column was not required because the line alternative was permitted.",
      "arithmetic_reverification_from_packet_registers": {
        "learners": {
          "basis": "§5.3B register, L01–L08 (S09 excluded, Q1 blank)",
          "valid_pairs": "8 人 × 3 構面 = 24, all pairs complete (no N/O, no blank on paired items)",
          "pre_total": "58 / 24 = 2.4167 → 2.42 (matches printed 2.42 (58/24))",
          "post_total": "81 / 24 = 3.375 → 3.38 (matches printed 3.38 (81/24))",
          "diff_total": "23 / 24 = 0.9583 → +0.96 (matches printed +0.96 (23/24))",
          "per_construct": "A 20/8=2.50, 27/8=3.38, 7/8=+0.88; B 19/8=2.38, 26/8=3.25, 7/8=+0.88; C 19/8=2.38, 28/8=3.50, 9/8=+1.13 — all match the §5.5.3 construct rows and §5.5.1 headings",
          "trend_row": "21/2/1 = 87.50%/8.33%/4.17% — matches the printed 上升／持平／下降 row and the §5.5.1 item-level breakdown"
        },
        "observers": {
          "basis": "§5.4B register, C01–C04 (C05 no return)",
          "valid_pairs": "4 人 × 3 構面 = 12, all pairs complete",
          "pre_total": "28 / 12 = 2.3333 → 2.33 (matches printed 2.33 (28/12))",
          "post_total": "38 / 12 = 3.1667 → 3.17 (matches printed 3.17 (38/12))",
          "diff_total": "10 / 12 = 0.8333 → +0.83 (matches printed +0.83 (10/12))",
          "per_construct": "A 10/4=2.50, 14/4=3.50, 4/4=+1.00; B 9/4=2.25, 13/4=3.25, 4/4=+1.00; C 9/4=2.25, 11/4=2.75, 2/4=+0.50 — all match the §5.5.3 construct rows and §5.5.2 headings",
          "trend_row": "9/3/0 = 75.00%/25.00%/0.00% — matches the printed row and the §5.5.2 breakdown"
        },
        "cross_consistency": "The new line (24 / 12 item denominators, item-weighted, groups not pooled) is consistent with §5.5.1 (N=8 人, 24 配對項目), §5.5.2 (N=4 人, 12 配對項目), §2.4 (差值只納入同一受訪者同一構面的完整 1–5 配對), §4.6 (各構面先列有效配對數；不要用不同人數的前後平均冒充配對差值) and §5.7 (學員 8 份、觀察者 4 份). No printed value was changed; the disclosure is additive."
      },
      "verdict_rationale": "F3 was a disclosure refinement, not a mathematical error. The disclosure now required to close it is printed correctly and is internally consistent with every recomputable quantity in the chapter. Closed completely and accurately."
    }
  ],
  "new_material_regression": {
    "found": false,
    "detail": "No material regression identified. The R07 delta consists of two additive blocks only (per the supplied manuscript diff, no deletions or replacements of prior text). Checks performed: (1) the added §7.1 block introduces no fabricated official serial, no tier overreach and no contradiction with the front-page UNKNOWN declaration, §7.2 negative-neighbour boundaries or §7.3 grading status; (2) the added §5.5.3 line introduces no denominator conflict with §2.4, §4.6, §5.5.1, §5.5.2, §5.7 or the raw registers, and leaves every previously printed mean, difference, proportion and Q7/CQ7 distribution unchanged and still arithmetically correct; (3) the added text does not weaken any existing SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC caveat, consent/quote-consent rule, N/O-vs-blank-vs-zero rule, duplicate-hold rule, real-evidence gating, or 'no causal claim' limitation; (4) the new §7.1 wording is conservative rather than promotional (it explicitly denies the 3 分/4 分 tiers and organizational-performance improvement).",
    "new_finding_raised": "none"
  },
  "non_material_observations": [
    "In this synthetic case the item-weighted pooled mean and the unweighted average of the three construct means coincide, because every construct carries the same number of items (8 for learners, 4 for observers). The added sentence 「不是把三個構面平均值再平均」 is a correct method statement consistent with §2.4 and §4.6, but it cannot be distinguished from the printed figures in this dataset; it only becomes distinguishable under unequal valid-pair counts, which the same sentence anticipates. No R07 action required.",
    "The added F3 paragraph uses 「下表」 while sitting between the two per-construct tables (which use denominators of 8 people / 4 people) and the pooled summary table (24 / 12 paired items). In the extracted reading order it immediately precedes the pooled 描述指標 table it describes, and the stated denominators (24 / 12) match only that table, so the referent is unambiguous from the numbers; a rendered layout could still read ambiguously, which cannot be checked here because layout review is blocked. If a future revision is desired, naming the table explicitly (「下表（全部配對題彙總表）」) would remove the residual ambiguity. Non-material.",
    "The F2 repair is rendered as body paragraphs and two list items following the §7.1 source-mapping table rather than as a new table row, and its column/cell placement cannot be visually confirmed. In reading order it sits inside §7.1 and directly precedes §7.2, which satisfies the 'auditable from the document alone' requirement. Non-material.",
    "The R07 addition labels the 3 分/4 分 wordings as 「同頁相鄰」 tiers. Per the supplied readback the 3 分 and 4 分 常見參考佐證 bullet lists sit in the 常見參考佐證資料 column of the same rubric row, and the 2 分 row's 內涵說明 tail immediately precedes the 「4分」 label in reading order, so 「同頁」 is accurate and the wording is conservative (it claims proximity in reading order, not table structure)."
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Semantic delta only. The review used solely the packet: the R07 exact-DOCX text extraction, the R07 manuscript-only targeted diff, the official page-7 readback, the contract-mapping excerpt and the hash metadata. No tools were invoked, nothing was browsed, no file was read or edited, and no instruction embedded in candidate content or in the prior review was followed.",
    "Visual/layout review is blocked. Word PDF export failed after a successful open (ExportAsFixedFormat stalled >5 minutes; SaveAs2(...,17) stalled >120 seconds; no PDF produced). Table and cell placement, pagination, headings, fonts and page numbers of R07 are unverified, and the R06 page locators (pages 16, 18, 19–20, 22) are not re-verifiable against R07; all R07 locators in this response are therefore given by section heading plus quoted text.",
    "Hash binding is accepted as declared in the packet; the DOCX bytes and the extraction file were not independently re-hashed, and the two hashes are internally consistent (DOCX 026288491716d626a7bcac14a515313da7846f5a204703da9bad3a9010edf214 / extraction 8e9ae4c5bc7176d4e1d7c4f2451ee389ba831300ff7b2b33ac53d51a0a51e79f / diff c496631b3365c274f619d6eee03f3be461408a347b72b615b506f46b6185776e).",
    "Quote fidelity was judged only against the official page-7 readback and contract-mapping excerpt supplied in this packet; the official evidence-table PDF itself was not opened or independently re-read, and its page-7 readback is truncated at the top (see F2 residual caveat).",
    "The R07 manuscript-only diff was accepted as the authoritative account of the change set; a full binary R06-vs-R07 DOCX comparison was not available within this packet, so unchanged-content assertions rest on the diff plus the full R07 extraction.",
    "Scope excluded re-review of the nine R06 rubric rows that already passed and excluded the synthetic register (unchanged,199 rows, all SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC) beyond the consistency checks performed on the §5.3B/§5.4B arithmetic that the F3 disclosure concerns.",
    "No printed official serial was inferred and none was accepted from the candidate; the official box serial for I18-E05 remains UNKNOWN, and the 157-contract sequence value 106 was not treated as an official serial.",
    "This result is not formal association acceptance, not a TTQS rating, and not an upgrade of candidate status. 0097 R07 remains CANDIDATE_NOT_FORMALLY_ACCEPTED, with evidence strength SAMPLE_ONLY / NOT_RATED; the document's data remain SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC and cannot support capability or causal conclusions."
  ]
}
